services.name: Document Services
services.short: Apply for or renew identity documents, certificates, and affidavits.
services.description: Get help with government identity documents, citizenship proofs, and official certificates at your local service centre.
requirements: A valid government photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)

services.name: Permits and Licences
services.short: Guidance and processing for municipal permits, trade licences, and approvals.
services.description: Speak with a municipal service officer about residential approvals, trade licences, vehicle endorsements, and building clearances.
requirements: Site plan / Property tax receipt or deed

services.name: Tax Assistance
services.short: Help with property tax assessment, municipal dues, and revenue forms.
services.description: An officer will guide you through municipal assessment, property tax payment records, challan generation, and dispute resolution.
requirements: Property assessment number / Unique property ID
Previous tax payment receipts or demand notice
Bank passbook copy if requesting refund or reconciliation

services.name: Housing Support
services.short: Assistance with public housing schemes, allotments, and tenant support.
services.description: Consult with civic housing counsellors on public housing allotments, registry verifications, and welfare housing schemes.
requirements: Income certificate / proof of household income
Proof of current residence (rent agreement / electricity bill)
Aadhaar cards of all family members

services.name: Small Business Help
services.short: Registration guidance, MSME certification, and local vendor permits.
services.description: One-stop facilitation for micro and small enterprises seeking local trade licensing, vendor stands, or MSME registration guidance.
requirements: Business Owner Photo ID and PAN card
GSTIN or MSME Udyam registration (if already initiated)

services.name: Community and Welfare Services
services.short: Pensions, disability support, senior citizen schemes, and welfare benefits.
services.description: Enrol or verify eligibility for social welfare schemes including senior citizen pensions, disability pensions, and student subsidies.
requirements: Disability / Caste / BPL certificate if applicable
